title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Fix missing postMessage source validation
head: sentinel-fix-postmessage
body:
🚨 Severity: HIGH
💡 Vulnerability: Missing postMessage source validation allows malicious iframes to spoof state.
🎯 Impact: Malicious iframes can alter the application state and potentially cause unauthorized actions or data leakage.
🔧 Fix: Added ev.source === window validation to the message event listener.
✅ Verification: Tested to ensure messages from same window are accepted, and others are ignored.
